Privacy Policy

㈜코멕트 (COMMECT, the “Company”) respects personal information. This policy explains how information submitted through the website’s inquiry form and briefing sign-up form is handled.

Last updated: 23 November 2026

1. Information collected and how

The website forms collect the following. Inquiries: inquiry type, company, contact name and email address (required), and phone number and message (optional). Briefing sign-ups: company, contact name and email address (required). Please do not include identity numbers, financial or health information, or other sensitive or unnecessary information in your message.

The Company does not store form submissions in a separate database. When a form is submitted, its content is delivered to the Company’s business email.

2. Purposes

Inquiry information is used to identify the inquirer, review and respond to the inquiry, and maintain related business communication. Briefing sign-up information is used to identify the subscriber and to send the coffee market briefings (Coffee Daily, Monthly Report) by email, based on the separate consent given at sign-up. It is not used for any other purpose.

3. Retention

Inquiry information is kept only for as long as needed to handle the inquiry and related communication, and deleted without delay once that purpose is fulfilled. Briefing subscription information is kept until the subscriber unsubscribes or withdraws consent, and is then removed from the mailing list and deleted. Where a separate transaction creates a statutory retention obligation, only the relevant records are retained separately for the legally required period.

4. Deletion procedures and methods

When information is no longer needed, any statutory retention obligation is checked before deletion. Electronic records are deleted using methods intended to prevent recovery, and paper records are shredded or otherwise destroyed. Information retained by law is used only for that retention purpose.

5. Third-party disclosure

Personal information submitted through the form is not provided to business partners or other third parties without consent, except as permitted by law. If disclosure is needed for partner discussions, the recipient, purpose, information concerned and retention period are explained and any required consent is obtained.

6. Data processing providers

The Company entrusts the following processing tasks.

Zoho Corporation: business email service (delivery and storage of form content, sending the briefing emails).

Vercel Inc.: website operation and transmission of form submissions. Submissions are processed in transit only and are not stored.

Changes to these tasks or providers will be reflected in this policy.

7. Overseas transfer

Personal information submitted through the forms may be processed and stored outside Korea on the servers of the providers above.

Recipients and countries: Zoho Corporation (United States), Vercel Inc. (United States). Information transferred: the items entered in the form. Timing and method: sent over encrypted connections when the form is submitted. Purpose and retention: the tasks in section 6 and the periods in section 3.

If you prefer that your information is not transferred overseas, you can contact us by phone (+82-10-4836-5159) instead of using the web forms.

8. Your rights

You may request access, correction, deletion, restriction of processing or withdrawal of consent by contacting sales@commect.ai. Requests are handled after identity and applicable legal requirements are checked, and the outcome is communicated. You can unsubscribe from the briefing at any time with the unsubscribe link at the bottom of each email or by writing to sales@commect.ai. If a request cannot be fully fulfilled, for example because of a statutory retention obligation, the reason is explained.

9. Consent and optional information

You may decline consent to the collection and use of personal information and to receiving the briefing by email. Without consent for the required information, the web form cannot accept your inquiry; without consent to receive it, the briefing cannot be sent to you. Optional information may be left blank.

10. Safeguards and privacy contact

The Company will maintain appropriate organisational and technical safeguards, including management of access permissions, to protect personal information. Privacy enquiries and rights requests can be directed to ㈜코멕트 (COMMECT) at sales@commect.ai or +82-10-4836-5159.

11. Policy changes

Material changes to purposes, information collected or retention arrangements will be announced on the website with their application date. Separate consent will be obtained where required by applicable law.
